en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from someone else, from Aban, from Abdul Rahman, from Humran, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one in Ihraam can wear the trouser when there does not happen to be a loin cloth with him; and he can wear the two shoes when there does not happen to be any slippers with him’.
en.sarwar: 6. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from more than one person from ‘Abd al-Rahman from Humran who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One in the state of Ihram can wear trousers if one does not find loincloth and al-Khuffayn (shoes) if one cannot find Na’l (sandals). ‘“(Fatwa best explains this Hadith)
